scope: Frozen-S mechanism transfer to planar homography texture baking; not full NeRF/3DGS paper reproduction
initialization: same training-image mean as original L2
mask_source: saved training-only L2 warmup predictions (600 updates); masks frozen during new baking
feature_model: official DINOv2 ViT-S/14, ImageNet normalized, resized to 392x518, patch grid 28x37

methods.dino_ssim_soft: DINO 384->64->1 ReLU/softplus MLP predicts sigma from frozen L2 modified SSIM target (1-L)(1-C)(1-structure); local 11x11 window; patch mean; S=1/(2sigma^2). Inspired by On-the-go; no feature-neighbor regularizer, no dilated sampling, no joint online updates.
methods.dino_cosine_soft: DINO affine+softplus sigma trained with min(1,2-2cos(DINO input,DINO warmup)) target; S=1/(2sigma^2). Soft-weight control for the next method, not a paper result.
methods.dino_cosine_hard: Same learned sigma as cosine-soft; bilinear sigma upsampled, S=1[1/(2sigma^2)>1]. WildGaussians-inspired masking only; no per-Gaussian appearance, densification, or online refresh.
methods.sam_region_median: Training warmup RMS > per-view valid median; 3x3 majority; saved disjoint SAM regions with >40% excluded votes are excluded whole. Cached SAM partition includes connected components in uncovered pixels. Inspired by object-aware masking in Robust3DGaussians; no logistic decision boundary, no exact original SAM IoU procedure.

evaluation: Existing frozen 33 OBB / 21 majority-occluded OBB, 2026 actual background, identical evaluator PSNR/LPIPS/static control. No 2026 for feature extraction, mask fitting, baking or parameter selection.
policy: Report every prespecified method and all three seeds; no tuning from new evaluation results
